title: No edge to vertex zero
statement: For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape symbols, bit string $x$, and nonnegative integers $s,u$, there is no edge from vertex $u$ to vertex $0$ for input $x$ and radius $s$.
